services.name: Court Summons
services.desc: If there is an early payment discount option on your traffic summons, you may mail the plea amount to the court or bring it to the court office during office hours. Payment must be received or postmarked no later than 20 days from the summons date. If you fail to pay within 20 days, you must appear in court on the date and time listed on your summons. If you mail the payment, you must return your signed and dated pink copy. By signing and dating the summons, you are entering a guilty plea, accepting the points noted on your summons, and waiving the rights listed on the back of your summons.
